continuity.arc_goal: Implement linked workflows with complete lifecycle management: MVP (create/complete/cancel/remove), Link GC (bidirectional records, purge guard, cross-partition cleanup), and VO onCompleted handler registration. Ship server-side runtime complete with handler callbacks on child completion.

progress_update.summary: We designed and spec'd the onCompleted handler registration feature for virtual objects. This allows VOs to register a named Exclusive handler at link creation time that fires when the linked child completes. We went through a thorough interview process, wrote a complete spec, ran two rounds of plan review, and resolved all issues. The spec is ready for implementation.
progress_update.goal: Implement VO onCompleted handler registration — allowing virtual objects to react to linked child workflow completion via named handler callbacks registered at link creation time. Complete runtime support from link creation through child completion and handler invocation.
accomplished: Conducted detailed interview covering mechanism, timing, scope, arguments, error handling, mutability, storage, observability
Ran two rounds of plan review — resolved all HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW issues
Designed type refactoring: EdgeLabel+LinkState → LinkRelation+ChildStatus with complete() transition method
Resolved failure argument inconsistency: proto-encoded Failure bytes using existing Value/Failure pattern, applied consistently to both HandlerInvocation sink and onCompleted
Confirmed encode_handler_argument implementation path: InvocationError → journal_v2::Failure → proto::Failure → encode_to_vec()
progress_update.now: Spec is finalized at docs/design/vo_child_link_on_completed.md. All plan review issues resolved. Ready to begin implementation.
next_steps: Implement type refactoring: LinkRelation + ChildStatus replacing EdgeLabel + LinkState
Update proto (domain.proto Link restructure + LinkCommandMessage completion_handler_name field)
Update HandlerInvocation sink for consistent failure encoding
Write TDD tests: happy path (child completes → handler fires) + unhappy path (child canceled → Failure argument)
constraints: VO parents only (SDK controls, no server-side validation)
Children can be VOs or workflows
Handler name stored in ChildStatus::Running on ParentOf record — consumed at Running→Completed transition
No changes to response sinks, outbox messages, or completion fan-out path
RemoveLink: deleting ParentOf is sufficient — stale LinkCompletionNotification handling covers cleanup
encode_handler_argument uses two-step chain through journal_v2::Failure → proto::Failure
Handler invocation is fire-and-forget with normal retry semantics
Only workflows can enter Completing — VOs complete immediately regardless of links
Links keyed by (local_service_id, remote_service_id, edge_label) with edge_label in key
Cross-partition links from day one — all link operations use outbox messages
decisions: No new LinkedCompletionResult proto wrapper — reuse existing Value/Failure pattern
No server-side parent scope validation — SDK controls API surface
ChildStatus::complete() method handles Running→Completed transition and extracts handler name atomically
are_linked(a, b) checks both directions — used for cycle prevention in CreateLink
VO clear state preserves ChildOf records — only deletes outgoing ParentOf links and notifies children
Removed label field entirely — links identified by child_service_id, not arbitrary label string
Extracted cancel_linked_children helper used by cancel (Invoked/Suspended/Paused + Completing) and kill (Completing)
Link barrier check moved outside sinks/retention guard — workflows always enter Completing with running links
No active_children_count — query link table for Running links instead of maintaining denormalized counter
Completion delivers Result<T, E> only — no status field, no inline frozen graph
Completing variant carries InFlightInvocationMetadata + buffered ResponseResult
RemoveLink included in MVP — graph curation is load-bearing
End-to-end integration test included in MVP scope
Cancellation is local per node — each node cancels its own direct children
HandlerInvocation targets VirtualObjectHandlerType::Exclusive — handler runs under object's exclusive lock
CreateLink proto uses result_completion_id field (not RawCommand metadata) matching AttachInvocation pattern
Lite decoding for CreateLink/RemoveLink returns graceful DecodingError — DataFusion skips these entries
risks: Updating HandlerInvocation sink (Section 5) may require adjusting existing handler_invocation_sink_queues_callback_on_child_completion test
